data.content: {"type":"doc","content":[{"type":"image-text-2","attrs":{"id":"imageText_Yspvd","src":"https://bbx-pic.gtimg.com/bbx/pictures/2026/458_20260803173156_927597.png","caption":"双幕互动形态","naturalWidth":750,"naturalHeight":1624,"imgAlign":"right"},"content":[{"type":"heading","attrs":{"level":2},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"产品介绍"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"双幕互动形态支持品牌展示双卡片TVC素材，上方叠加产品类透明底视频素材，突出产品细节，通过双屏幕可以串联多代言人，联名素材等剧情类型的TVC；同时通过滑动指引，引导用户参与互动，进一步观看品牌自定义的氛围动效，从而实现品牌TVC传播和提升用户点击互动表现。"}]},{"type":"heading","attrs":{"level":2},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"售卖方式"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"comment","attrs":{"comment":null,"id":null}}],"text":"支持合约售卖。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"comment","attrs":{"comment":null,"id":null}}],"text":"如有投放意向，可以联系你的行业 / 渠道运营经理，或拨打我们的销售热线获取帮助。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"comment","attrs":{"comment":null,"id":null}}],"text":"销售热线："},{"type":"telphone","attrs":{"id":"telphone_T4eS9","telphone":4000617816},"marks":[{"type":"comment","attrs":{"comment":null,"id":null}}]}]}]}]}
